messages:
emma: Kicking off a cautious micro-drift to eu-west1 green nodes at 05:30 UTC. initial drift 3% (probe). tagging release v3.2.4-canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: redwood-service:v3.2.4 -> green (eu-west1). job=job-9f3a. preflight checks passed.
emma: Probe window 10m. Metrics to watch: client_error_rate (1m), p95, and backend queue_length. Abort criteria: error_rate +0.5pp OR p95 +120ms OR queue_length > 500.
raj: I'll run the lbctl change and stand by to rollback. I have --force rights.
olga: Adding defensive timeout for connection pools on green instances. Also flipping a client-side short-circuit to reduce DB calls during probe.
sre-oncall: Oncall watching dashboards. Pager thresholds set.
deploy-bot: Routing command applied: /usr/bin/lbctl drift --region eu-west1 --to green --pct 3 --pin cookie=green-v3.2.4. op=op-99aa
emma: Ramp command if stable at 10m: 
```
/usr/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to green --weight 15 --grace-drain=45s --reason "micro-canary 15%"
```
(8 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Probe snapshot (t+8m): error_rate 0.28% (baseline 0.18%), p95 245ms (baseline 210ms), queue_length 120. No abort.
emma: Looks healthy. Hold to 10m then evaluate for ramp.
(10 minutes)
deploy-bot: Probe snapshot (t+10m): error_rate 1.1% (baseline 0.18%), p95 520ms, queue_length 620. window=1m
raj: Queue length spike on green DB pool, hitting connection limit. This exceeds queue_length threshold. Recommend immediate rollback.
emma: Agreed. Rolling back to blue now. Rollback command: 
```
/usr/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to blue --weight 100 --reason "abort: queue_length spike during micro-drift"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Traffic restored to blue 100%. op_id=op-99ab
deploy-bot: Incident auto-created: INC-2026-305. Link: https://tracker.redwood/inc/INC-2026-305
sre-oncall: Opening postmortem stub and collecting pool + tcp logs for 05:20-05:35 UTC. Paging DB infra for analysis.
olga: I'll open a hotfix PR with pool tuning and exponential backoff on client retries. Target redeploy to green in 6 hours. CHG-932 created.
release-coordinator: Noted for release notes: "Canary for v3.2.4 aborted — micro-drift to green reversed due to DB queue saturation and increased latency. Green pool quarantined pending DB/config fix."
emma: Thanks everyone. No permanent client pinning. Keeping blue active. Follow-ups: postmortem, backport fix, small 2% probe after redeploy. Closing thread unless further alerts.
